SOP-09 Rev 3 — Tank Shell Evaluation Procedure
MRPL Mechanical Maintenance. Effective 2025-01-10.
1. Symbols
D = nominal tank diameter (m)   H = maximum fill height (m)
G = product specific gravity     S = allowable shell stress (MPa)
E = welded joint efficiency
2. Minimum required shell thickness (one-foot method)
t_min = 4.9 x D x (H - 0.3) x G / (S x E)   [mm]
3. Thresholds (two distinct limits)
Retirement thickness t_ret = t_min. A course below t_ret requires repair or re-rating.
Alert thickness t_alert = t_min + 1.0 mm. A course below t_alert but at or above t_ret
requires increased monitoring.
4. Corrosion rate
CR = (previous thickness - current thickness) / years between surveys   [mm/year]
Where no previous reading exists, the corrosion rate shall not be assumed; the
course is referred for engineering review.
5. Remaining life
RL = (current thickness - t_min) / CR   [years]
6. Next inspection interval
Interval = lesser of (RL / 2) and 15 years. The 15-year cap applies.
7. Worked example
For D=25.0 m, H=13.0 m, G=0.85, S=137 MPa, E=0.85:
t_min = 4.9 x 25.0 x 12.7 x 0.85 / (137 x 0.85) = 11.36 mm
t_alert = 11.36 + 1.0 = 12.36 mm
